message.content:
{
  "business_name": "Nova Wear",
  "summary": "Relaxed everyday clothing in denim, linen, and knitwear, designed in SoHo, New York, for people who want comfortable, well-made pieces for daily life.",
  "customers": "An estimate: adults roughly 25 to 50 who want comfortable, low-maintenance everyday clothes for work, weekends, and travel, and who value natural fabrics and a calm, understated look.",
  "tone": "calm, warm, understated, practical",
  "best_days": ["Monday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"],
  "brand_colors": ["#232f3e", "#efe8da", "#2e5a86", "#9e3b32", "#d6cdbf"],
  "products": [
    {
      "name": "Indigo Denim Jacket",
      "photo": 1,
      "description": "Back view of a dark washed denim jacket with contrast stitching and metal buttons at the cuffs and hem, hanging on a wooden hanger against a pale wall.",
      "category": "denim"
    },
    {
      "name": "Linen Dress",
      "photo": 2,
      "description": "Cream linen dress with a gathered waist, three-quarter sleeves, and red embroidered cuffs, hanging on a wooden hanger against a warm beige wall.",
      "category": "linen"
    },
    {
      "name": "Fair Isle Knit",
      "photo": 3,
      "description": "Folded blue knit sweater with a white snowflake pattern, resting on a light oak table beside a window with a sheer curtain.",
      "category": "knitwear"
    }
  ],
  "content_pillars": [
    "fabric and material close-ups",
    "styling one piece in a few simple ways",
    "behind the SoHo design and making process",
    "building a small seasonal capsule wardrobe",
    "fit and comfort notes for everyday wear"
  ],
  "visual_style": "Soft natural light, plain warm or pale walls, simple wooden hangers and light oak surfaces, uncluttered framing, and a quiet, lived-in mood that lets the natural fabrics read clearly.",
  "best_post_hint": "A hanger or flat-lay shot pairing the cream linen dress, the blue knit, and the indigo denim jacket together as one relaxed outfit would likely earn the most saves, since the muted palette and natural textures in the photos clearly work as a set.",
  "avoid": [
    "no hype words or hard-sell urgency",
    "no invented discounts, free shipping, gifts, or limited-stock claims",
    "no prices, addresses, or awards the owner did not state",
    "no cluttered, over-filtered, or heavily retouched backgrounds",
    "no loud graphics or trend-chasing edits that clash with the calm look"
  ]
}
message.reasoning_content:
The user wants a compact style profile as a JSON object. Let me carefully study the business data and the three photos.

Business: Nova Wear. Sells "products" but description clarifies: relaxed everyday clothes designed in SoHo, New York — denim, linen and knitwear. Ships across the US. Link: instagram.com/novawear.nyc.

Photos:
1. A dark indigo/black denim jacket, back view, on a wooden hanger against a pale off-white/gray wall. Visible contrast stitching, metal buttons at cuffs and hem.
2. A cream/ivory linen dress with three-quarter sleeves, gathered waist, and red embroidered cuffs (folkloric floral pattern). On a wooden hanger against a warm beige/taupe wall.
3. A folded blue knit sweater with a white/cream Fair Isle / snowflake pattern, on a light oak table, with a window and sheer curtain in the background, soft natural light.

Now build the JSON.

business_name: "Nova Wear" (given).

summary: one sentence: what the business sells and to whom. "Relaxed everyday clothing in denim, linen, and knitwear, designed in SoHo, New York, for people who want comfortable, well-made pieces for daily life."

customers: who buys, with age range and situation (one string). Estimate. "Adults roughly 25 to 50 who want comfortable, low-maintenance everyday clothes for work, weekends, and travel, and who value natural fabrics and a calm, understated look." I should mark as estimate? The rule says when you estimate, say it is an estimate. The age range is an estimate. I'll phrase "an estimate" maybe. Let me include "estimate" word. e.g., "An estimate: adults roughly 25 to 50..." Good.

tone: 3-6 words describing the voice. "calm, warm, understated, practical" — that's 4 words. Good.

best_days: English day names when posts work best. For everyday relaxed clothing, weekends and weekday evenings? Typically fashion/casual wear posts well on weekends and maybe Monday (new week outfit) and Friday (weekend plans). I'll pick ["Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday", "Monday"]. Reasonable.

brand_colors: 2-5 hex colors seen in photos or implied. From photos: deep indigo denim (#1f2a3a or #232f3e), cream/ivory linen (#f2ede1 or #efe9dc), warm beige wall (#d8cfc2), red embroidery accent (#a83232 or #9e2b2b), blue knit (#2f5d8a or #2e5a86), light oak wood (#c9a878). I'll pick 5: indigo #232f3e, cream #efe8da, knit blue #2e5a86, terracotta red #9e3b32, warm beige #d6cdbf. Let me ensure hex format #rrggbb.

products: array of three.
- Photo 1: name "Indigo Denim Jacket", description "back view of a dark washed denim jacket with contrast stitching and metal buttons, on a wooden hanger against a pale wall", category "denim".
- Photo 2: name "Linen Dress", description "cream linen dress with gathered waist, three-quarter sleeves, and red embroidered cuffs, on a wooden hanger against a beige wall", category "linen".
- Photo 3: name "Fair Isle Knit", description "folded blue knit sweater with a white snowflake pattern on a light oak table by a window", category "knitwear".

content_pillars: 3-5 recurring themes. e.g., "fabric and material close-ups", "how to style one piece three ways", "behind the SoHo design process", "seasonal capsule wardrobes", "customer styling and fit notes". Keep 4-5.

visual_style: lighting, backgrounds, mood. "Soft natural light, plain warm or pale walls, simple wooden hangers and light oak surfaces, calm and uncluttered, with a quiet, lived-in mood."

best_post_hint: one sentence: what kind of picture would get most saves, from what is visible. "A flat-lay or hanger shot pairing the cream linen dress with the blue knit and the indigo denim jacket to show a complete relaxed outfit, since the natural fabrics and muted palette clearly work together."

avoid: things posts must not do. e.g., "no hype words or hard-sell urgency", "no invented discounts, free shipping, or limited-stock claims", "no cluttered or over-filtered backgrounds", "no prices or addresses not stated by the owner", "no loud graphics or trend-chasing edits that clash with the calm look".

Check constraints: no prices, addresses, awards invented. Good. No offers promised. Good.

Now ensure JSON only, valid. The "photo" key is 1-based number or null. All have photos.

Let me double check tone word count: "calm, warm, understated, practical" = 4 words. Good (3-6).

best_days: I'll provide 4 days.

Now produce final JSON only.
